quotes.author: Julian Diaz
quotes.text: Got the sandbar charter on the 27ft deck boat with Captain Dante. Thanks for an unforgettable experience and making my family day out on the water one to always remember. We will definitely be back soon and if you're in town and book a charter please make sure you ask for captain Dante.

quotes.author: Jasmine H
quotes.text: I can’t wait to come back. Don’t forget to book a chartered boat for a sunset cruise with Captain TJ and ask him if you can see Cuba!!!! Inside joke. Let him take you to Dolphin Playground.

quotes.author: Kira Munson
quotes.text: We did the 4 hour sandbar cruise. This was by far the best part of our trip. Captain Emily was amazing and answered all of our million questions. I would recommend to anyone!

quotes.author: Mary Leusink
quotes.text: We took this tour yesterday and it was absolutely amazing! Definitely a highlight of our vacation. Our captain was amazing!! This is a must to do for all!!!

quotes.author: Suzanne Masters
quotes.text: My husband and I went out for a sunset cruise. It was a beautiful evening. Dante was a great captain! Would highly recommend!

quotes.author: Bill Burke
quotes.text: Best captain ever. Super special tour of marathon. Well done!!! Definitely worth the money. Fabulous
